Hints: Factor the area expression.;Find two numbers with product 12 and sum 7.
Solution: Factor the area: x^2 + 7x + 12 = (x + 3)(x + 4). These monic linear factors give sides x + 3 and x + 4; both are positive when x>0. Swapping the side order is accepted.
